note: Closed motion vocabulary. reducedMotionFallback records what the CLONE actually does under prefers-reduced-motion (cited); 'unchanged' means no reduced-motion branch exists for it (gaps are noted). Timings are CLONE_SPEC.md values unless a later motion QA on the original corrected them (signature start 1.00 s, draw 2.88 s; ?open delay 2.5 s; wheel holds the camera with a box open; FOV snap on close).

loader-draw.description: Mark draws as two masked strokes (easeInOutCubic, stroke 1 over progress 0-0.58, stroke 2 over 0.44-1); shown progress chases real progress at rate 7/s, never faster than 1.6 s; then opacity 0.6s and mark scale 1.06 over 0.8s house ease.
loader-draw.fallbackNote: The clone only removes the settle keyframe under reduced motion (index.css); the stroke draw still follows load progress. CLONE_SPEC says the original skips the drawing: a known gap.

portrait-arrival.description: Every portrait tile flies home easeOutCubic over 1300-2200 ms from (60-180)*k units out; delay rand*1500 ms + 9 ms per grid step from the centre; scale 0.35 -> 1.
portrait-arrival.fallbackNote: No reduced-motion branch for the arrival in cosmos.js.

halo-drift.description: Halo pieces loop from the dark to the silhouette at 0.05-0.12 cycles/s with a flow-field swirl; 260 motes drift into the face in 5-9 s trips.
halo-drift.fallbackNote: Not covered by the reduced-motion branches.

signature-draw.description: Signature pen line draws in 2.9 s (original measured 2.88 s) with curvature-dependent pen speed, a 60-unit bright tip and a nib glow; first draw starts 1000 ms after the loader is done (original measured 1.00 s); redrawn 350 ms after returning from a flight; hidden (opacity 0.6s) when away.
signature-draw.originalMeasurement: measured on the original by the motion QA pass of 2026-11-04 (values relayed to this build; no capture file in the repo)

scroll-travel.description: Camera travels along -Z: dist chases target with 1 - e^(-4 dt) (250 ms time constant), no end. Wheel x0.55, ArrowUp/Down +-160, PageUp/Down/Space +-600, touch x1.6/px with a release-only fling (x16, decays e^(-3.5 dt), frame-rate independent). While a box is open wheel/touch do not move the camera; they accumulate toward the 120-unit close.
scroll-travel.fallbackNote: Reduced motion: dist = target (no damping), cosmos.js.

pointer-parallax.description: Pointer smoothed at rate 1.5/s; camera drift 0.5 units at the portrait rising to 3.0 while flying; look-at moves 0.6x.
pointer-parallax.fallbackNote: Reduced motion: kp = 0 and drift = 0 in cosmos.js.

rewind.description: Back to the portrait: reverse flight easeInOutCubic over min(2600, 1200 + 14 * sqrt(dist)) ms; any input cancels it.

tile-hover.description: Hovered tile tinted 6% toward white with a 1.4% white edge, cursor pointer; instant.

evidence.needle: - **Hover**: the tile colour is mixed 6% toward white

hero-fade.description: Hero opacity 0.6s ease + transform 0.9s house ease; away: translateY(60px), boxed: translateY(30px).
hero-fade.fallbackNote: index.css reduced-motion block removes the hero transition.

arrow-bob.description: Start-pill arrow bobs translateY -2px <-> +3px, 1.8s house ease, infinite alternate.

flybar-reveal.description: Flybar shows with body.far (dist > 60): opacity 0.5s ease, translateY(14px) -> 0 over 0.7s house ease.

fade-layers.description: Top and bottom dark fades (body pseudo-elements) fade in with body.far, opacity 0.6s ease.
fade-layers.fallbackNote: Opacity-only; not in the reduced-motion block.

side-reveal.description: Social block shows with body.side: opacity 0.45s ease, translateY(10px) -> 0 over 0.6s house ease; lifts to pad + 52px while flying (bottom 0.4s ease).

evidence.needle: transition: opacity 0.45s ease, transform 0.6s var(--ease), bottom 0.4s ease

box-slide.description: Glass box open: translateX(-40px) -> 0 over 0.75s house ease, opacity 0.45s; close: 0.6s / 0.45s, visibility after 0.6s. Background blurred in WebGL (13-tap separable, uSoft rate 6/s, field dimmed 35%); portrait reframes beside the box at rate 5/s; on close the FOV snaps back (original: 37.49 -> 34.37 deg within 32 ms) while the view offset eases.

evidence.needle: transition: transform 0.75s var(--ease), opacity 0.45s ease, visibility 0s, width 0.6s var(--ease)

box-slide.fallbackNote: CSS transitions removed; no WebGL blur pass (soft target 0 when reduced).
box-slide.originalMeasurement: measured on the original by the motion QA pass of 2026-11-04 (values relayed to this build; no capture file in the repo)

view-crossfade.description: Active box view fades in opacity 0.45s with 0.1s delay; outgoing view fades 0.35s.

evidence.needle: .view.on { opacity: 1; visibility: visible; transition: opacity 0.45s ease 0.1s

focus-drift.description: The opened tile slides 30% closer along its camera ray over 10 s (cosine ease); returns at rate 3.2/s on close.

underline-grow.description: 1px underline grows from the left: background-size 0 -> 100% 1px over 0.35s house ease.

pill-press.description: Solid pills scale 1.04 on hover over 0.2s ease.

chip-toggle.description: Chips: background / colour / border 0.2s ease; checked = white bg, black text.

evidence.needle: transition: background 0.2s ease, color 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease

field-focus.description: Inputs: border .45 and bg .08 on focus over 0.2s ease.

evidence.needle: outline: none; transition: border-color 0.2s ease, background 0.2s ease

toast-rise.description: Toast in: opacity 0.25s, translateY 8px -> 0 over 0.35s house ease; auto-hides after 1.8 s.

menu-panel.description: Phone menu: opacity 0.35s ease, translateY(-10px) -> 0 over 0.5s house ease; visibility delayed 0.35s on close.

hud-follow.description: Hover label pill follows the pointer, centred 14px above it; shown/hidden instantly.

case-reveal.description: Case blocks fade + rise as they enter: opacity 0.6s ease, translateY(30px) -> 0 over 0.9s house ease; IntersectionObserver threshold 0.08, rootMargin -8% bottom; pair images staggered 80 ms.

evidence.needle: .rv { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(30px); transition: opacity 0.6s ease, transform 0.9s var(--ease); }

case-reveal.fallbackNote: case.css reduced-motion block shows blocks with no transition.

image-develop.description: Images fade in on load, opacity 0.5s ease.

evidence.needle: opacity: 0; transition: opacity 0.5s ease; object-fit: cover

next-case-hover.description: Next-case link: title underline (offset 8px) and thumbnail scale 1.04 over 0.6s house ease.
